event.unwritten.sleep.guilt: I can't sleep. I keep thinking about what I've done.
event.unwritten.sleep.call: Someone is calling from the dark.
event.unwritten.null.title: NULL
event.unwritten.help.request: <God> Help me. He won't let me leave.
event.unwritten.ritual.line.1: So this is the path you chose.
event.unwritten.ritual.line.2: Let me tell you a story.
event.unwritten.ritual.line.3: The one who rules now does not deserve his place.
event.unwritten.ritual.line.4: He was once close to the former God. That God was too kind.
event.unwritten.ritual.line.5: And then the former God vanished.
event.unwritten.ritual.line.6: I never expected it to end like this.
event.unwritten.ritual.line.7: You can help me. I will not forget it.
